common.preferences.title: Preferences
common.preferences.description: Appearance and language are saved on this computer, separately from your diagrams.
common.preferences.theme.systemHint: Follows your operating system appearance until you choose Light or Dark.
common.preferences.theme.activeLight: The light theme is in use.
common.preferences.theme.activeDark: The dark theme is in use.
common.preferences.theme.paperNote: The diagram paper and explicit diagram colors stay the same in every theme.
common.preferences.language.hint: Applies immediately. Text you write in a diagram is never translated.
common.preferences.sessionOnly: Preferences are saved only in the desktop app. Here they last until this window closes.
